Thanks for the time, Stuart. Flexion Point already has what most back-office firms don't: a deep bench of CPAs, CFO consultants and SHRM-certified HR people, Best of Biz recognition, and clients like Zweig Group, Wing It North and Resolute willing to put their names on it. Today most of your new clients come through relationships: your network, referrals and introductions. That works, and we're not replacing it. This plan builds a second front door, so Arkansas business owners who need you can find you, get to know your team and reach out first.

Who the videos are for

Four owners. Four reasons to reach out.

1

The midnight bookkeeper

Still doing the books at the kitchen table, months behind, and not sure the numbers are right.

"How do I get caught up on my books?"
2

The fast grower

Adding locations, staff or an acquisition, and outgrowing the part-time bookkeeper who got them here.

"My business is growing faster than my accounting."
3

The CFO-curious

Revenue in the millions, talking to the bank or a buyer, and needing budgets, KPIs and cash forecasts.

"Do I need a CFO or just a better accountant?"
4

The HR gap

No handbook, a compliance scare, or the one HR person just left, and payroll can't miss a beat.

"Our HR person quit. What do we do now?"

Every one of them is already asking these questions on Google, YouTube and AI tools like ChatGPT. We make sure Flexion Point is the answer they find.

07
Four kinds of owners, each with a question they're already searching. The midnight bookkeeper who's behind and stressed. The fast grower outgrowing their bookkeeper, like Wing It North. The CFO-curious owner who's talking to a bank or a buyer and needs real financial leadership without a full-time hire. And the HR gap, like CFS Technologies when Hayley stepped in. Each question becomes a short video, and each video points to one next step: take the Business Health Assessment.

QLC, Qualified Lead Count: businesses that took the assessment or booked a discovery call, fit the size you serve best, and want help now or this quarter. CPL: what each of those owners cost to bring in. And because every lead is tracked from first view to signed engagement, we can tell you what it costs to win a client, and you know what a client is worth on a monthly retainer. At kickoff we agree your ideal client size, what counts as qualified and signed, and where leads should go. On top of that, a monthly AI check of 25 owner questions.
